create.name: Monique Brignoni
create.bio:
Monique Brignoni is a teacher and animal intuitive who works with the last chapter of a companion animal's life, treating it as a spiritual passage for both the animal and the person who loves it. Before this work she was a personal assistant to a prince; the loss of her own cat, Rami, led her into roughly a decade of study of how animals die naturally, alongside a much longer personal spiritual practice. She runs her work under the name Animalchemy and lists herself as a member of The Shift Network's faculty.

Her best-known programme, Walk Your Pet Home, prepares guardians to stay calm and present as an animal ages and approaches death, and to keep a sense of connection afterwards. She also trains and certifies pet death doulas, and says graduates now work in more than ten countries. Alongside this she offers one-to-one mentoring, a monthly online circle for pet guardians, and a longer inner-work programme on recognising old patterns and trusting one's own guidance, using animals and grief as the doorway. Her teaching is gentle and practical, and she keeps room for humour, since animals rarely follow anyone's plan.

courses.title: The Sacred Pet Doula Certification Path
courses.description: A selective training for people who want to accompany animals and their families through the end of life as a pet doula. Entry begins with a free discovery call to see whether the path suits you.

courses.title: Walk Your Pet Home
courses.description: A three-part online series for guardians who want to prepare for an animal's final stage before a crisis comes. It covers preparing, letting go and staying connected afterwards, and includes three months in her membership circle.

courses.title: Conscious PetParent Collective
courses.description: An online membership for animal lovers with a monthly live gathering with Monique, a place to ask questions and occasional guest speakers. Its themes are the bond with an animal, ageing, transitions and conscious dying.

courses.title: Private Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one sessions shaped around each client, covering grief and loss, purpose, the bond with animals and support for working pet doulas. She draws on intuition, spiritual inquiry and meditation.

courses.title: Return to Your Essence
courses.description: A guided inner-work journey on noticing the beliefs and protective habits that shape your choices and learning to trust your own sense of what is true. Grief, change and the relationship with an animal are often the starting point.

courses.title: The Lightkeeper's Path
courses.description: A follow-on to Return to Your Essence about bringing what you have found inwardly into your voice, work and leadership. It is aimed at people who guide or create for others and want to be seen without losing themselves.

courses.title: What Our Pets Teach Us About Life & Death
courses.description: A recorded presentation of about 45 minutes that looks at dying as a natural process and at how a guardian's emotions and energy affect the animal's journey. Stories of animals she has accompanied illustrate each point.

courses.title: Journey with Grace Meditation
courses.description: A recorded introduction and twenty-minute guided meditation with music for staying calm beside an animal near the end of life. It is meant to be used daily during that period.

free_resources.title: The 5 Sacred Shifts That Change Everything at The End of Your Pet's Life on Earth
free_resources.description: A free e-book for anyone facing an animal's last weeks or grieving one already gone. It sets out five changes of attitude that move a guardian from fear towards trust.
